request:
镜头 s20：纪录片中引用的旧资料影像，时长 9 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-arch58）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['ENG broadcast camera', 'scan lines']）：Locked look "2058 broadcast news archive" (style preset sp01-arch58): a shoulder-mounted 2/3-inch ENG broadcast camera; broadcast tape, later dubbed; an 18x broadcast zoom at auto iris; filter none; grade: hot clipped whites, crushed murky shadows, chroma smear on reds; light: floodlights, emergency strobes and whatever is there; texture: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, compression noise, an occasional tape dropout; urgent news footage of a disaster operation, the operator running with the crew.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：archival footage quoted inside a documentary
导演意图（自然语言）：手持，昏暗，画面有压缩噪点。地下城的小公寓里，十六岁的宋念坐在床沿，抱着爸爸的笔记本，盯着墙上的屏幕。屏幕的蓝光在她脸上一闪一闪。环境声：屏幕里含混不清的新闻播报声、通风管道的嗡嗡声。
情绪：anxious, lonely, hushed
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, handheld with a slight unsteady drift
景深与虚实：Low-light noise and soft focus; her face and the notebook the only sharp area.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival-looking handheld frame inside a cramped underground apartment in 2058: 16-year-old Nian with a low ponytail and blunt bangs sits on the edge of the bunk in the blue glow of a small wall screen showing a news broadcast (abstract shapes only, no text), clutching her father's worn hardback notebook to her chest, waiting. Blocking lock: Nian sits on the bunk at frame left, the notebook against her chest; the glowing wall screen is at frame right; the round porthole window behind her.
Picture 2: Song's notebook with the crayon drawing taped on the first page (prop reference; role: prop reference). A worn hardback engineer's notebook lying open: on the first page the child's crayon drawing (a big black box with one red eye and many small smiling coloured boxes holding hands) is taped in with yellowed tape; around it and across the facing page, an adult's dense pencil diagrams of networks, many small circles linked by lines, arrows and loops spreading outward. Only abstract shapes, no legible words or numbers.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：indistinct news anchor voice from the wall screen, ventilation duct hum
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：

16:9 horizontal, single clip 9.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2058 broadcast news archive" (style preset sp01-arch58): a shoulder-mounted 2/3-inch ENG broadcast camera; broadcast tape, later dubbed; an 18x broadcast zoom at auto iris; filter none; grade: hot clipped whites, crushed murky shadows, chroma smear on reds; light: floodlights, emergency strobes and whatever is there; texture: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, compression noise, an occasional tape dropout; urgent news footage of a disaster operation, the operator running with the crew; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium shot, handheld ENG camera with one slight unsteady drift from medium shot to a slightly tighter medium shot; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: Nian at frame left on the edge of the bunk, the notebook against her chest; the shadowed gap between the bunk and the screen at frame centre; the glowing wall screen at frame right; foreground: the near edge of the bunk in shadow; background: the round porthole window and the dim apartment wall. Start: Nian sits still on the bunk edge, both arms wrapped around her father's worn notebook, shoulders curled forward, eyes fixed on the wall screen. Middle: the screen's blue light flickers across her face, picking out her low ponytail and blunt bangs, a red shape on the screen smears to the right and its highlights clip hot white; her thumb presses into the worn corner of the notebook cover and her gaze shifts from the screen to the dark porthole behind her. End: she pulls the notebook tighter against her chest, lowers her chin and holds still, jaw set. Mood: anxious, lonely, hushed. Blur: low-light noise and soft focus, her face and the notebook the only sharp area; the wall screen, porthole and apartment wall fall soft and grainy, with faint scan lines, compression noise and one brief tape dropout rolling through the frame. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
indistinct Mandarin Chinese news anchor voice from the wall screen, ventilation duct hum, low electrical buzz from the screen, a faint drip along a pipe, the soft friction of the notebook cover under her thumb, her quiet breath; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
